cites.quote: the list's row type gains `cancellation_reason: string | null`

findings.suggested_fix: Name the row type (for example a ListRow extends SummaryRow) or state that SummaryRow itself is widened and why that is safe.
findings.text: CO-1 says 'the list's row type gains cancellation_reason' without naming it; the list uses SummaryRow, which toSummary shares with doctorRepo, patientRepo and dashboardService, so implement cannot tell whether to widen it or add a list row type.

rubric_items.reason: Built on existing repo/service/route layers and the shared AppointmentTable with an opt-in prop following hide?; no new infrastructure, no SQL change; web goes through client.ts as the architecture requires.
Every story S-1 to S-6 is mapped to components; cell rule covers 60-char boundary, ellipsis, dash for other statuses, as-entered text; dashboard/doctor/patient use other endpoints so stay unchanged.
EP-1 items[].cancellationReason has name, type, nullability, format and example; the new prop has type and default; column placement and cell rule are testable.
Claims C1-C9, C11-C15 verified against code and A-02; C10's usage by four pages and CO-7 rest only on the component's declaration fact, not on the pages that use it.
Trade-offs given for the separate list type, opt-in prop, code-point counting and client-side shortening.
Clear and compact; small inconsistency in change status between the API and web AppointmentListItem types, and CO-1's row type is not named.
